verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the BugSnag product. The SmartBear MCP server lets external agents reach BugSnag data, which is a different capability. Error grouping, automatic assignment rules and correlated events are rule-based features, not AI-generated insights. An in-product AI assistant is a plausible capability for an error-monitoring SaaS, so the axis applies and absence of evidence yields none.
